content:
Yes — it’s from an alleged early instant-message exchange by **Mark Zuckerberg** shortly after launching **Thefacebook** at Harvard.

The fuller widely quoted version is usually:

> “Yeah so if you ever need info about anyone at Harvard  
> just ask.  
> I have over 4,000 emails, pictures, addresses, SNS.”  
>  
> Friend: “What? How’d you manage that one?”  
>  
> “People just submitted it.  
> I don’t know why.  
> They ‘trust me.’  
> Dumb fucks.”

It was reported by **Business Insider / Silicon Alley Insider** in 2010 and became infamous as an example of early Facebook privacy concerns. It’s also often associated with the era portrayed in *The Social Network*, though the quote itself is from the leaked chat logs, not originally a movie line.
